read_scope: Original public ESA TTE overview read; TT/RC/BE and actual switched physical devices. No universal Ethernet rate.
Original TTTech PMC public product features read: three channels, 100/1000 Mbit/s full duplex. Product limits distinct other controllers.
Original ADCSS2016 PDF actual page32 TTTech controller sheet read: three channels, 10/100/1000M RGMII versus 10/100M RMII; send/receive VL, partitions and COM-port limits scoped this device.
Original RUAG presentation23October2013 actual slides4-5 read: three traffic classes, global clock, perhop virtual-link schedules, gatekeepers and PCF delay compensation.

Original NASA/CR2012-217764 selected section2 read: SM/CM/SC roles, priority filtering, CS/CA/IN startup and clique recovery. Example topology and cycle counts are not defaults or universal fault proofs.

Original NASA/CR2012-217554 March2012 sections2/3.2 printed3-8 read: equal integration periods, cluster period, nonoverlapping perlink intervals, relative precision, permanence and explicit fault assumptions. Research model rather than full AS6802A normative conformance.
Original SAE publisher public AS6802A abstract14February2023 read. Synchronization/dispatch network scope excludes complete application CPU/memory architecture. Full licensed standard not read.
